unsafe_assumptions: Radio, physical scheduling/cache, exhausted firmware heaps and on-device display remain untested.
Interconnect and notifications are intentionally unsupported; neither is required by these two local audio modules.
recommended_probe: Install the updated Supervisor first, then BluetoothAudio. Verify discovery, pairing, test tone, AVRCP, disconnect/reconnect; next install Lyra and verify local music playback on 212x520 display.
